liam_ae: Heads-up: BankSweep wants a slim POC for their colocated HSMs. Requirements: customer-managed keys (never export), signed rotation chain (every 7 days), and low-latency remote-signing for 300 rps bursts. They asked for a two-day dry-run. Need feasibility + minimal SOW. cc @ashish_se @nora_security

ashish_se: Feasible but need vendor PKCS#11 modules and a test acct. Two implementation choices: (1) our proxy does remote-sign over mTLS to their HSMs; (2) client-side signer where HSMs return partial sigs and client does aggregation. Option 2 lowers latency but depends on vendor support.

nora_security: Security checklist: FIPS certs, signed rotation logs, tamper-evident audit trail, and proof we never persist plaintext keys. For POC we can accept manual rotation if we get signed rotation artifact. Blocker: notarized third-party attestation is extra and not included in POC.

devops_claire: Infra asks: VPN peering or dedicated circuit? VPN fine for POC. We'll deploy staging-proxy in a peered VPC and run load tests. Need their allowlist + vendor module by EOD.

liam_ae: Procurement asks pricing: flat POC fee vs per-op surcharge. They prefer flat predictable fee. Propose small POC flat + optional monthly reserved tier for production.

ashish_se: Agreed. Deliverables for POC: runbook, attestation doc (internal), one dry-run showing rotation proof, and perf report. Sample audit snippet we'll provide:

"2026-06-11T10:22:43Z INFO rotation completed key=bs-01 rotated_by=manual proof=sha256:deadbeef"

deploy_bot: staging-proxy deployed in us-east-1 at 2026-06-10T22:05Z

liam_ae: I'll request vendor .so, IP ranges, and custodian contacts. If they insist on notarized attestation now, escalate to sales-lead.

nora_security: I'll draft the POC security Q&A and a minimal runbook snippet for the SOW.

liam_ae: Thanks team — aiming to run dry-run Thu morning. Will update when vendor artifacts arrive.
